notes: 1954 six-unit midcentury stucco block at the Bay Street corner, E side of Hyde. Three storeys, flat roof with a thin plain coping, smooth pale khaki-green painted stucco (lit #d4cf9f), white aluminium frames. Hyde front: a wide two-light window near the corner on the upper storeys, a centre window, a narrow stair stack of multi-pane windows at centre-right, a wide window at the far right; ground: small windows and a dark glazed entry door under the stair stack, no garage, no shop. Bay Street face (edge 0) is a windowed flank. The small railed balcony on storey 2 has no key. Wider two-light windows (1.5 m); wall a touch greener (#d0cd94); ground window sills raised; entry leaf dark. Slim metal cap instead of the coping slab; two-light windows with no meeting rail (sashRows 1, sashCols 2); black railed juliet balcony on storey 2 at the centre window (fireEscape to storey 1 only); the stair stack at 0.66 drawn as three closely stacked multi-light windows (flat panels) between the landings over the dark entry door; ground: two small windows and the dark door, with stucco panels under the sills; far-right window kept. The stepped grade has no key. Wall shifted yellow-green (#d3cf96); upper windows are now flush two-light sliders (upperWindowSpans ribbon, mullionM 0.75, no meeting rail, slim sill, 1.1 m tall); stair stack redrawn as a tall 3x4-light window over a small 3x3-light window between the landings; ground windows plain single-light (no mullion, near-zero transom), different sill heights, wider stucco panels hide the frame legs; dark brackets under the storey-2 cage; light coping instead of the dark cap. Mirror claim skipped again; wall nudged yellow-green (#d7d395); tall stair window split into two stacked units by a white rail; leg posts under the storey-2 cage removed; entry door widened to ~0.95 m with an opaque near-black leaf. Steep grade has no key. Wall warmed to lit khaki-olive #d7d395 CONFIRMED; horizontal meeting rail on the twin windows CONFIRMED (sashRows 2); ground windows/door and no far-right window already match; parapet unchanged. Rework: wall d8d4a2, upper windows raised (sill 1.1/head 2.6), fire-escape platform raised to the window sill via fireEscapeLanding, dark entry glazing, taller downhill plinth under the small ground window. Wall nudged to d6d194; left windows shifted/widened (0.035-0.175); storey-1 centre window replaced by a door-height dark French door (plaque) behind the balcony, deck lowered to the floor line, drop ladder removed; ground stucco plaques (seam lines) removed. Diagonal slab brackets have no key. Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
